description: Published active configurable product with an active in-stock variant, plus its guest PDP for the Nth eligible variant by SKU (first if not given): text attributes, guest price, inventory, parent category path/brand/links. KB: Product Detail Page; Custom Price Lists; Managing Inventory.

quantityUsed.description: Highest quantity the test sets on the PDP; the variant needs at least this inventory and the guest tier price is picked for it

store.description: Store code the webstore under test serves (ZnodePortal.StoreCode)

minTiers.description: Optional: the parent or the variant must have at least this many tier prices on the price list the variant is priced from (e.g. 1 when the test checks SPECIAL PRICE OFFERS); left out = any

variantRank.description: Optional: which eligible variant (active, inventory >= quantityUsed on the store) to describe, 1-based in SKU order; left out = the first, as before
